tools.name: extract_coi
tools.description: Read an ACORD 25 Certificate of Insurance into structured data (spec §3.1). Returns a signed envelope. Use it when you want the fields and will apply your own rules; for a verdict against requirements you supply use validate_coi instead - it extracts as part of its work, so calling both on one docum

tools.name: check_carrier
tools.description: Check an insurer by NAIC code or name: known, licensed, and adequately rated (spec §3.3). Provide at least one of naic or carrierName, plus state (required). Answers from an UNVERIFIED seed dataset (§4.5 datasetStatus) and returns a signed envelope. Needs no document. Use it when you have a carrier

tools.name: validate_coi
tools.description: Extract an ACORD 25 certificate AND judge it against a requirement profile (inline or profileId), returning a signed Verdict with per-check results, flags, and a risk score (spec §3.2). Use extract_coi instead if you only want the fields without a verdict; use check_carrier only when you have no cer

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "extract_coi" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
